policy: Every authored sample names its actual cause. Code proves a project damage path, not an original-work visual reference. User rules override code. Grade dimensions and colors remain authored project design, not sourced facts. Minecraft source routing takes priority over the existing four project enums; mc-damage-map.json covers the inspected registry.

user_thermal.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：烧伤只有可能是脚部或者全身性质，不存在局部；补充：焦枯纹理，全身烧伤略微缩小
user_thermal.supports: Only sole and whole-body thermal scopes; no isolated scalp burn or thermal core-hole sample.

user_hair.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：砸击随体表凹陷，裂伤处断发直接消失，不做散落头发
user_hair.supports: Shared dent deformation and local severing only at a genuine break.

user_filling.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：中枢馅与周边材质区别过强、边界感太强
user_filling.supports: Continuous material family without an isolated organ-like shell.

injury_code.supports: Actual damage-source mapping and project grades; not a visual authority.

body_signs.supports: Existing mechanical opening grades; does not authorize arbitrary thermal holes.

body_l36.locator: L36 身体与面皮、足部与行动、馅与中枢馅
body_l36.supports: Elastic skin, heat-damaged sole and deep central filling. Original page timed out during this review; repository extract only.

dense_filling_e01.supports: Central filling described as denser filling; not a differently colored organ. Read on 2026-10-22; author labels the work personal setting. Numerical proportions are not adopted.

minecraft_1211.locator: DamageTypes registry plus actual projectile and damage callers; exact source paths and hashes inside
minecraft_1211.supports: Actual available Minecraft damage mechanisms; not a visual reference.

operation_friction.supports: ROLL/SLIDE accumulate actual grounded movement times floor roughness; threshold strike deducts accepted health. Pose alone is not a damage source.

wiki_burn_eh16.locator: EH16-008 綾蔵／shku，茎上个体受灼烧画格；本轮直接核看原图
wiki_burn_eh16.supports: 焦黑细点、烟熏与连续表皮，没有碎瓷状块面。仅采用材质语言，不采用局部火焰范围、幼体伤情或照抄原图。

user_transparency.locator: 2026-10-22 当前会话：无底贴图，避免肤色边框误盖眼睛；烧伤不应像即将碎裂
user_transparency.supports: No opaque skin-colored exterior; preserve organs outside actual injury; soot and desiccation instead of fracture plates.

friction_contact.label: 滚动／拖行摩擦
friction_contact.locator: OperationLife.tick actual movement/roughness -> strike(player,1); InjuryModel.kind ROLL/SLIDE -> SCRATCH
friction_contact.visual_boundary: 只在实际摩擦扣血后显示浅擦痕；普通滚动姿态本身不是 MC 伤害来源。

blade_cut.label: 刀刃切割
blade_cut.visual_boundary: Directional split; these samples do not claim to depict tooth spacing, projectile entry or explosion damage.

blunt_impact.label: 钝击／落物压击
blunt_impact.locator: kind: default DENT; crush: FALLING_ANVIL / FALLING_BLOCK
blunt_impact.visual_boundary: Compression precedes rupture; grade 1/2 preserve skin and hair topology.

hot_floor.label: 热地板接触足底
hot_floor.visual_boundary: Continuous underside and sole edge only; no scalp spot or thermal core hole.

body_fire.label: 全身着火
body_fire.locator: kind: IS_FIRE -> SCORCH; whole-body extent required by current user rule
body_fire.visual_boundary: Whole body and hair share continuous heat damage. Existing runtime anchor still conflicts with this scope.

arrow_impact.label: 箭矢刺入
arrow_impact.visual_boundary: 窄入口；高伤级不能凭空拓宽成露核洞。

wolf_bite.label: 狼的啃咬
wolf_bite.locator: DamageSources.mobAttack plus attacker Wolf; InjuryModel.kind bite classification
wolf_bite.visual_boundary: 由上下咬合范围形成参差缺损；不能把所有 mob_attack 都看作咬击。

explosion_impact.label: TNT／苦力怕等爆炸
explosion_impact.visual_boundary: 受压、撕裂的破口；没有着火事件不额外叠加焦黑。

cactus_contact.label: 仙人掌尖刺接触
cactus_contact.visual_boundary: 项目设计的离散细刺痕；MC 不提供每根刺坐标，不伪称逐刺复现，三档增加已有接触范围内的密度。

dripstone_impact.label: 滴水石锥尖穿压
dripstone_impact.visual_boundary: 宽尖锥穿压的纵向楔口，与箭的窄口区分；方向由上方落锥／下方石笋真实接触决定。

runtime_gaps: InjuryModel currently treats heated_awl as local SCORCH; incompatible with the current two-scope rule. No art is exported for that path.
IN_FIRE/LAVA currently use soleSite; fire context and whole-body coverage still need runtime integration.
BodySigns currently allows deep SCORCH to expose core; no corresponding thermal-only cavity is authored.

Cause-specific selection is not connected. Eight mechanical styles and two thermal scopes have three authored levels and explicit per-source coverage. MC supplies single entity hits rather than individual trident prongs or thorn coordinates; do not invent separate contacts.
